why: An entry file that listens or connects must shut down on purpose: SIGTERM and SIGINT close the server then the database; uncaughtException and unhandledRejection do the same and exit non-zero. Missing any one of the four leaves the pool open on that path.
bad:
const app = Fastify();
await app.listen({ port: env.PORT, host: '0.0.0.0' });
